notes: Version 2.61 records the Hopf-Dirac correction in TopologicalInvariants 1.2, the white paper 3.22 and GS-Note 2.5. The integer winding of the Hopf fibre is invariant for configurations in a fixed fibre or over a trivialising domain of the base, not in the whole fibre S^3; its identification with electric charge is not derived, since no relation between the internal fibre and an emergent electromagnetic potential is supplied, and charge quantisation is listed as open. The Hopf bundle is the bundle of the unit Dirac monopole over the internal base. The TopologicalInvariants entry, table row, open problems and graph node, the GS-Note entry and version lines, and the white paper version line are aligned, and TopologicalInvariants carries its new title. In the white paper, the association of winding 1 with charge e is a proposed identification and its superconductivity consequences are stated under explicit hypotheses.
